defmodule DistCache.Protocol do
  @moduledoc "Binary protocol encoder/decoder for distributed cache"

  @magic_header <<0xCA, 0xFE>>
  @max_key_len 250
  @max_value_size 1_048_576

  defstruct [:opcode, :key, :value, :flags, :ttl, :cas_token]

  @opcodes %{
    get: 0x00,
    set: 0x01,
    delete: 0x02,
    incr: 0x03,
    auth: 0x10,
    multi_get: 0x20
  }

  def encode(%__MODULE__{opcode: op, key: key, value: value, flags: flags, ttl: ttl}) do
    opcode_byte = Map.fetch!(@opcodes, op)
    encoded_key = encode_key(key)
    encoded_value = encode_value(value)
    key_len = byte_size(encoded_key)
    value_len = byte_size(encoded_value)
    # Total body length: key_len(2) + value_len(4) + flags(4) + ttl(4) + key + value
    body_len = 2 + 4 + 4 + 4 + key_len + value_len
    <<@magic_header::binary, opcode_byte::8, body_len::32-big,
      key_len::16-big, value_len::32-big,
      flags::32-big, ttl::32-big,
      encoded_key::binary, encoded_value::binary>>
  end

  def decode(<<0xCA, 0xFE, opcode::8, body_len::32-big,
               key_len::16-big, value_len::32-big,
               flags::32-big, ttl::32-big,
               rest::binary>>) do
    expected_rest_len = key_len + value_len
    if byte_size(rest) >= expected_rest_len do
      <<key_bytes::binary-size(key_len), value_bytes::binary-size(value_len), _::binary>> = rest
      {:ok, %__MODULE__{
        opcode: opcode_atom(opcode),
        key: decode_key(key_bytes),
        value: decode_value(value_bytes),
        flags: flags,
        ttl: ttl
      }}
    else
      {:error, :incomplete}
    end
  end
  def decode(_), do: {:error, :invalid_header}

  defp encode_key(key) when is_binary(key) do
    normalized = key |> String.trim() |> URI.encode()
    if byte_size(normalized) > @max_key_len do
      raise ArgumentError, "Key too long: #{byte_size(normalized)} > #{@max_key_len}"
    end
    normalized
  end

  defp decode_key(bytes), do: URI.decode(bytes)

  defp encode_value(nil), do: <<>>
  defp encode_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
    if byte_size(value) > @max_value_size do
      raise ArgumentError, "Value too large"
    end
    value
  end
  defp encode_value(term), do: :erlang.term_to_binary(term)

  defp decode_value(<<>>), do: nil
  defp decode_value(bytes), do: bytes

  defp opcode_atom(0x00), do: :get
  defp opcode_atom(0x01), do: :set
  defp opcode_atom(0x02), do: :delete
  defp opcode_atom(0x03), do: :incr
  defp opcode_atom(0x10), do: :auth
  defp opcode_atom(0x20), do: :multi_get
  defp opcode_atom(_), do: :unknown
end

defmodule DistCache.Pool do
  @moduledoc "Connection pool with consistent hashing"
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:nodes, :connections, :auth_token]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    nodes = Keyword.get(opts, :nodes, [])
    auth = Keyword.get(opts, :auth_token, nil)
    conns = Enum.map(nodes, fn node -> {node, connect(node, auth)} end) |> Map.new()
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{nodes: nodes, connections: conns, auth_token: auth}}
  end

  defp connect({host, port}, auth_token) do
    {:ok, socket} = :gen_tcp.connect(String.to_charlist(host), port,
      [:binary, active: false, packet: :raw])
    if auth_token do
      authenticate(socket, auth_token)
    end
    socket
  end

  defp authenticate(socket, token) do
    packet = DistCache.Protocol.encode(%DistCache.Protocol{
      opcode: :auth, key: "auth", value: token, flags: 0, ttl: 0
    })
    :gen_tcp.send(socket, packet)
    {:ok, _response} = :gen_tcp.recv(socket, 0, 5000)
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule DistCache.Client do
  @moduledoc "High-level cache client with multi-key operations"

  alias DistCache.Protocol

  def get(key) do
    packet = Protocol.encode(%Protocol{opcode: :get, key: key, value: nil, flags: 0, ttl: 0})
    send_command(key, packet)
  end

  def set(key, value, opts \\ []) do
    ttl = Keyword.get(opts, :ttl, 0)
    flags = Keyword.get(opts, :flags, 0)
    packet = Protocol.encode(%Protocol{opcode: :set, key: key, value: value, flags: flags, ttl: ttl})
    send_command(key, packet)
  end

  def multi_get(keys) when is_list(keys) do
    # Build a multi-get request with concatenated keys separated by null bytes
    combined_key = Enum.join(keys, "\x00")
    packet = Protocol.encode(%Protocol{opcode: :multi_get, key: combined_key, value: nil, flags: 0, ttl: 0})
    send_command(List.first(keys), packet)
  end

  def delete(key) do
    packet = Protocol.encode(%Protocol{opcode: :delete, key: key, value: nil, flags: 0, ttl: 0})
    send_command(key, packet)
  end

  defp send_command(key, packet) do
    node = select_node(key)
    GenServer.call(DistCache.Pool, {:send, node, packet})
  end

  defp select_node(key) do
    hash = :erlang.phash2(key, 1024)
    nodes = GenServer.call(DistCache.Pool, :get_nodes)
    idx = rem(hash, length(nodes))
    Enum.at(nodes, idx)
  end
end
